## Frequently asked questions

### Where is The Table?
A/100, Poonamallee High Road, Maduravoyal, Chennai.

### What facilities does The Table have?
Dessert jars, Red velvet, Black velvet, Tiramisu, Gianduja mousse, Salted caramel brownie, Raspberry heaven, Trio of chocolate, Dine-in, Order online.

### What are your opening hours?
Sunday to Saturday, 11 AM to 11 PM.

### Who makes the desserts?
Shriram Rajendran, a Le Cordon Bleu trained chef who has worked as a dessert chef at the Leela Palace.

### How do I reserve a table at The Table?
Pick your date in the booking section of this page and send it on WhatsApp, or call +91 99620 76600.
